confidence_note: The chart class, the db_repos predicate, the filter window, and the house CSV exporter are read from origin/main. Plate, case_number, and Claimed By name are cited columns that the aggregate SELECT does not project today. Repo Agent Name has no per-row source and stays blank. ClickHouse was not queried.
csv_lock_reason: Acceptance criteria allow CSV or Excel. All five classes in app/Filament/Exports/ return only ExportFormat::Csv. First Glance 42732 prefers CSV. Not a question.
synthesis: The LPR Repossessions bar chart has no export. LprRepossessionsQuery returns counts only. db_repos is uniqExactIf of (forwarder_org_id, agent_org_id, vin) where the status-3 hotlist's first_repossessed_at falls on or after claim_date minus 7 days. A new listing SELECT of that same set, for the active date toggle and auth()->user()->org_id, is the export. The existing aggregate SELECT stays. One file row per triple keeps the row count equal to db_repos. Plate comes from the hotlist row the funnel already joins. RDN case number is zod.hotlist_json_denormalized.case_number, blank when empty. Claimed By is the name of the claimed_by_org_id org. Repo Agent Name stays blank.

card.heading: LPR Repossessions
not_the_headline: deduped, which UniqueLprCaseClaims reads from UniqueLprCaseClaimsQuery
the description line N scans per LPR repo from RatioAgainstUniqueScans

ui_path.client_note: The acceptance criteria say the export respects current filters including client. This card has no client control. Org scope is auth()->user()->org_id. Do not add a client filter.
ui_path.org_binding: auth()->user()->org_id. Either forwarder org_id or agent_org_id. Impersonation changes the authenticated user.
ui_path.compact_path: CompanyMetricsOverview constructs the class and calls toStat(). Livewire does not mount the compact card.
ui_path.expanded_path: Dashboard::expandedCardComponents() mounts the same class with expanded=true when the card key is lpr-repossessions. That mounted bar chart is where the export button goes.
ui_path.headline_total: getCardTotal(): today and last_7d use currentPeriodTotal() which is window() db_repos. this_month is the last bucket of getMonthlyData(). last_month is the previous bucket.
ui_path.bars: getMonthlyData() always paints 13 UTC month buckets of db_repos. The date toggle highlights a month or replaces the description with the today/last_7d window. The export set is the headline window, not the sum of the 13 bars.
ui_path.chart_widget_actions: Filament ChartWidget does not implement HasActions. The chart view's afterHeader slot is the filter dropdown only. TableWidget is what implements HasActions, and that is where ExportAction is used today.

query_path.row_listing_note: window() and monthlySeries() normalize to {deduped, db_repos} integers. No method returns VIN rows.
predicates: ts BETWEEN utc start epoch AND utc end epoch
event_date BETWEEN toDate(utc start) AND toDate(utc end)
deduped groups by bucket, forwarder_org_id, agent_org_id, vin and takes min(claim_date)
query_path.deduped_aggregate: uniqExact((forwarder_org_id, agent_org_id, vin)). Same statement. Not the export stage.
query_path.hotlist_join: LEFT JOIN {zod}.public_hotlist FINAL WHERE _peerdb_is_deleted = 0 AND status = 3 ON org_id = agent_org_id AND vin, guarded by agent_org_id != 0. SELECT list is id, org_id, vin. plate exists on the table and is not projected.
query_path.recoveries_join: LEFT JOIN {clarity_db}.hotlist WHERE _peerdb_is_deleted = 0 AND toDate(first_repossessed_at, 'UTC') >= {floor}. No FINAL. ON ch.id = h.id AND h.id != 0. SELECT list is id, first_repossessed_at.
query_path.do_not_change: The chart's aggregate SELECT, the uniqExactIf predicate, the dedup triple, the backyard -7 window, and the either-side org predicate.

export_mapping.grain: (forwarder_org_id, agent_org_id, vin) that passes the db_repos predicate for the headline window
export_mapping.why_not_distinct_vin: db_repos counts the triple. A second agent org on the same VIN increments the chart. Distinct VIN would make the file shorter than the chart.

window.this_month: UTC month bucket of the last series point. Headline getCardTotal().
window.last_month: UTC month bucket of the previous series point.
window.today: viewer-local day, converted to UTC, via window().
window.last_7d: viewer-local last 7 days, converted to UTC, via window().

export_mapping.parity: COUNT of export rows for that window and org equals the chart db_repos for the same window and org. The 13-month bar series is not the export set.
export_mapping.implementation_shape: Add a listing query that reuses the claims and deduped CTE text and the same joins, then filters to the backyard predicate. Do not replace uniqExactIf in the chart statement with a row dump. Do not store row payloads in the shared monthly-series or window cache keys; those keys have a payload contract of counts only.

vin.proof: The materialized view writes upper(trimBoth(JSONExtractString(additional, 'vin'))). The dedup CTE drops vin = ''.

plate.source: zod.public_hotlist.plate on the status-3 row the funnel already joins (alias h). Empty string stays blank.
plate.not_a_source: billing_claim_events_v has no plate column. Documented case-claim additional keys are claimed_by_org_id, vin, and hotlist_id.
plate.also_on_table: clarity.hotlist.plate is the same order, already joined as ch for first_repossessed_at, and is not in that subquery's SELECT list. Prefer h.plate so the plan does not invent a second plate read.

rdn_case_number.source: zod.hotlist_json_denormalized.case_number, JSONExtractString(json, 'case_number'), joined on hotlist_id = h.id. Nullable. Blank or omitted when null or empty.
rdn_case_number.not_a_source: clarity.hotlist does not project case_number. remote_order_id is the external order id (HotlistExporter labels it Order ID). Do not substitute remote_order_id. Otto's investigation payload maps a display key named case_number onto hotlist_remote_order_id; that is a different surface.
rdn_case_number.join_note: This join is not in LprRepossessionsQuery today. Adding it for a column must not change which triples pass uniqExactIf. PG-030 sentinels stay.

claimed_by.source: zod.public_orgs.name for agent_org_id. The billing materialized view sets agent_org_id from JSONExtractInt(additional, 'claimed_by_org_id'), documented as the claiming agency. Blank when agent_org_id is 0 or the name is missing.
claimed_by.not_a_source: The case-claim additional payload has no person name. Do not invent a user column. The forwarder org (API key owner) is not Claimed By.

repo_agent_name.why: No per-row repo-agent name column on billing_claim_events_v, public_hotlist, clarity.hotlist, hotlist_json_denormalized, or the documented case-claim additional keys. org_meta.properties.rdn_agents is the org-level GetOrgAgents SOAP cache, not a name for one VIN. Leave the column blank. Do not join rdn_agents.

exporter_pattern.call_site_shape: ExportAction on a table headerActions list, exporter class, hidden when the table is empty, modal false, chunkSize 250, fileName from the export key.
exporter_pattern.filename_note: Acceptance criteria name the date. The leaderboard exporter puts the export key in the filename instead. Follow the acceptance criteria for this file.
exporter_pattern.do_not_sync_block: The VIN listing runs on the existing exporter job. It does not run inside getData() or toStat().
exporter_pattern.chart_gap: ChartWidget has no ExportAction hook. Plan adds the action on the expanded chart without turning this card into a table and without exporting any other card.
